lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mo6O8 (reduced formula LiMo3O4) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mo adopts both four-coordinate O and octahedral O environments. O centers appear in tetrahedral and five-vertex environments. Corner-sharing is observed between Li octahedra and O tetrahedra, between Mo octahedra and O tetrahedra, and between O tetrahedra and O five-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
